notes.title: Better controller support, bug fixes and lower price
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37545106/ccb2fe336f2ebb7c7fa6ab39ec0791597f95b591.png[/img]

This update is really something you've been waiting for! Today I uploaded a new version v.1.01 which contains the following updates and fixes:

[list]
[*] Better controller support - You can now play the game entirely by controllers. Even menus and options can be handled from your favorite controller
[*] It is now possible to cripple the rocket building factory to give you some extra time to finish all the tasks at hand
[*] Small bug fixes, which didn't impact the game, but was a torn in my eye
[/list]

After much thought I have also lowered the price on this game, to make it accessible to even more people, who enjoys old school arcade action games.

notes.title: DevLog #14: More additions and tweaking
notes.content:
Development is still going strong and each week I manage to add or tweak a little something in the game. This time I have adjusted the player gun, so it automatically aims for the nearest target within shooting range.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37545106/ec4e171f2e47eabfdc15deec90888ae6feb4f1aa.gif[/img]

I have also had time to add/change these things.

[list]
[*] Discovered helipads will now also be shown on the minimap to make it easier to figure out where to fly for refuelling and repairs
[*] Reduced the strength of flying enemies. They are now an easier target
[*] Ingame UI can now be doubled in size, making it easier to read on the big screens. Access it in the pause menu
[/list]

I really like how the development is progressing and I still feel that I'm on track for the final release :-)

notes.title: DevLog #7: Addition of the upgrade shop
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37545106/fcd9f96d7f03316ac055550928aada460002c775.png[/img]

These last couple of days I have been working mainly on improvements, bugfixes and the addition of a shop, where you will be able to buy upgrades for your twin-copter.

When you kill of an enemy asset, you will earny money. Use the money to buy needed upgrades in the shop. 

The following upgrades will be available:

[h3]Hydra rockets[/h3]
[i]These small rockets are pure fire and forget. They will travel on a direct path towards the ground. Objects in their way will get a decent amount of damage.[/i]

[h3]AIM-9 Sidewinder[/h3]
[i]Air-to-air missile which will home in on enemy aircraft within a certain distance[/i]

[h3]Defensive flares[/h3]
[i]Deploy these when you have an enemy missile on your tail. If you have full power and no damage, you will be able to dodge a missile, but if you're damaged it is safer to release some flares[/i]

[h3]Upgraded armour[/h3]
[i]These double kevlar platings will protect your aircraft from all kinds of fire. They will decrease the amount of damage you take when getting hit. Beware though, that the platings will decrease in sufficiency over time[/i]

[h3]Mark MK-82[/h3]
[i]Unguided glide bomb, which will do a lot of damage to all ground structures[/i]

[h3]AGM-65 Maverick[/h3]
[i]Optical guided ground missile, which will home in on any active enemy structure. Do a fair amount of damage to light structures[/i]

[h3]Increased capacity[/h3]
[i]With this hull expansion set, you will be able to carry more weapons on your missions[/i]

[h3]CBU-1 Cluster bomb[/h3]
[i]A mean bomb which will deploy many small unguided glide bomblets, which will do a lot of damage and secondary damage to all structures[/i]


Only the hydra and Mark MK-82 boms will be available in the demo version, which will be released on 9th june at the Steam Game Festival - Summer edition.
